content: Consensus across multiple 2026 comparison sources: LangGraph/Mastra are overkill for simple sequential/tool-calling workflows and add state-machine ceremony and deployment friction (LangGraph TS trails Python, non-trivial on Vercel); Vercel AI SDK's tool-loop is the right-sized primitive for Next.js apps needing streaming + tool calls without durable workflow orchestration; hand-written dispatcher is viable but reimplements what the SDK already gives for free.
